title: Category:PvP Builds
html:
Builds that work in the Player versus Player arena. Some of them are good for solos, other for groups.

The PvP (player versus player) arena is a very distinct game from the PvE (Player versus Environment) game. PvP builds, skills, and strategies differ greatly from those of PvE, and this guide will introduce the uninitiated player to some of those aspects.
